# Paperlane: Scan to PDF

> Paperlane is a free iPhone app that scans paper documents into clean, multi-page PDFs using Apple's on-device VisionKit edge detection and perspective correction. Scanning, real multi-page PDF export, and the local library are free forever, with no watermark, no scan limit, and no account. An optional one-time Paperlane Pro purchase adds searchable OCR, page merging, JPG/PNG export, and password-protected PDFs. Everything runs on-device; nothing is uploaded.

## App
- [Download on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/paperlane-scan-to-pdf/id6780053638): Free, iOS, Productivity.
- [Pricing](https://getpaperlane.vercel.app/pricing.md): Free to scan and export PDFs; Paperlane Pro is a one-time EUR 4.99 purchase (no subscription).
- [FAQ](https://getpaperlane.vercel.app/#faq): Free tier, offline use, watermarks, cost, privacy, and OCR.

## What it does
- Scan to PDF: automatic edge detection and perspective correction (Apple VisionKit).
- Real, multi-page PDFs that open, print, and share anywhere — never image-only, never watermarked.
- Local, on-device library you own — documents never leave the iPhone.
- Paperlane Pro (one-time): searchable OCR text layer (Apple Vision), combine pages, export JPG/PNG, password-protect PDFs.

## Privacy
- No servers, no account, no cloud sync. Every scan is processed and stored on-device.
- Works fully offline, including airplane mode.
